items.name: Grilled Biscuit
items.description: A warm Southern buttermilk biscuit split in half, buttered, and grilled face-down on the flat top until crisp and toasted.

items.name: Biscuit & Sausage Gravy
items.description: A freshly baked, split buttermilk biscuit topped with rich, creamy white gravy packed with savory sausage crumbles.

items.name: Chicken Biscuit
items.description: A tender, grilled chicken breast filet served inside a split, warm buttered biscuit.

items.name: Sausage Biscuit
items.description: A grilled, seasoned pork sausage patty served inside a freshly baked buttermilk biscuit.

items.name: Chicken Sausage Biscuit
items.description: A savory grilled chicken sausage patty placed inside a split warm biscuit.

items.name: Bacon Biscuit
items.description: Crispy strips of hickory-smoked pork bacon served inside a warm buttermilk biscuit.

items.name: City Ham Biscuit (1)
items.description: A slice of grilled hickory-smoked city ham served inside a warm biscuit.

items.name: Country Ham Biscuits (2)
items.description: Two warm buttermilk biscuits filled with thick-cut, salty, dry-cured country ham.

items.name: Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit
items.description: A grilled pork sausage patty, cooked egg, and melted American cheese assembled inside a fluffy biscuit.

items.name: Bacon, Egg & Cheese Biscuit
items.description: Strips of crispy bacon, a cooked egg, and melted American cheese stacked inside a split warm biscuit.

items.name: Chicken Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit
items.description: A grilled chicken sausage patty, a cooked egg, and melted cheese stacked inside a buttermilk biscuit.
